description: This file defines a C# class 'Route' which interacts with JavaScript through JSInterop in a Blazor application. It provides a method to trigger routing behavior outside the Blazor context.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: A service class for invoking JavaScript routing outside of the Blazor framework.

methods.description: Invokes a JavaScript function to change the route outside of Blazor.
